metadata.summary: Alycia Baumgardner, an undisputed world champion at super-featherweight, moved up to lightweight to capture the IBF world title when she shut out Elif Tur Nurhan in Texas.
metadata.content: Alycia Baumgardner outclasses Elif Nur Turhan to become two-weight world champion, winning IBF lightweight title | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Alycia Baumgardner outclasses Elif Nur Turhan to become two-weight world champion, winning IBF lightweight title Alycia Baumgardner dominated Elif Tur Nurhan to win the IBF world lightweight title; her war of words with British rival Caroline Dubois continued after the fight; Baumgardner is now a two-weight world champion after beating a hard puncher who had never lost before Monday 9 November 2026 06:39, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the IBF lightweight world title fight between Alycia Baumgardner and Elif Nur Turhan Alycia Baumgardner, an undisputed world champion at super-featherweight, moved up to lightweight to capture the IBF world title when she shut out Elif Tur Nurhan in Texas. Baumgardner won a unanimous decision after 10 rounds as she overcame Nurhan at College Park Center in Arlington. The American won 100-90 on all three cards, beating a hard puncher who had never lost before. Baumgardner hurt Turhan at times, shaking her up in the third and seventh rounds. Image: Baumgardner outclassed a hard puncher She poured in punches, with Nurhan feeling the weight of those attacks in the ninth round.
